title: Chapter 158 The Dispute In The God Prison
content:
Chapter 158 The Dispute In The God Prison

Unexpectedly, they are all the same.

But I think so, after being locked up for so long, and being able to come out and having some benefits, the fool would refuse.

"Are you willing to fight against aliens with us?"

Lu Xue asked symbolically.

There was no hesitation in the cell.

"Of course, I've been upset with that alien race for a long time."

Hearing this, Lu Xue nodded and then signaled to the prison guard beside her.

After a moment, a squeak.

The prison door opens.

A man with a somewhat shabby but tall long hair slowly walked out of the prison door.

At this moment, the long-haired man was greedily breathing the fresh air outside the cell, his expression very intoxicated.

"Hey, madman, so many years have passed, are you okay?"

At this time, Lei Yin, who had not left, suddenly mocked him.

Hearing Lei Yin's words, the long-haired man's eyes suddenly became bloody.

"Leigou, I just came out, don't force me to do it!"

Boom!

Suddenly, the aura at the peak of the super god realm suddenly surged out of the long-haired man.

There was no slightest concern.

In an instant, the entire Divine Prison was shaken.

Seeing this scene, Lei Yin sneered, and then his breath burst out.

Rumble!

At this moment, the two super-divine pressures collided with each other, and the surrounding space began to tremble wildly.

"Enough!"

"Are you two finished?!"

At this time, Lu Xue, who had been silent on the side, suddenly shouted angrily.

Hearing Lu Xue's scolding, both of them frowned slightly.

Seeing this scene, Old Zhou's face darkened.

A faint dragon power slowly overflowed from the body of the arrogant green.

Lu Xue's face was also extremely cold.

"Closing them both back."

Lu Xue said coldly.

Hearing this, Lei Yin and the others were stunned.

Looking at Lu Xue's cold face, the two of them suddenly felt thrilled in their hearts.

At this moment, they seemed to see the invincible empress.

Suddenly, a sense of regret arose from the bottom of my heart.

Boom!

At this moment, two terrifying auras suddenly soared into the sky.

It was the aura of Ao Qing and Mr. Zhou.

"Your Highness the Princess has already spoken. Do you two still need me to invite you?"

Old Zhou looked at the two of them with a gloomy face and said.

Ao Qing looked even more ferocious, "Get back quickly, you dare to make my little master angry!"

Upon hearing this, Lei Yin and his two faces suddenly looked extremely ugly.

They were indeed a little impulsive just now, but it was naturally impossible to let the two give up easily with this hard-earned freedom.

"Your Highness, please give me a chance."

Lei Yin hesitated when he looked at Lu Xue.

The long-haired man next to him remained silent and just looked at Lei Yin lightly.

"I've given you a chance."

Lu Xue refused Lei Yin's request without hesitation.

She came here, to be honest, that was a huge opportunity here, but as a result, the people here didn't cherish it.

She will not be held under her command of the uncontrollable person.

Otherwise, one day I will be betrayed.

Lu Daosheng had taught this truth a long time ago.

"Girl, please let me out. I am very grateful to you. I am very unhappy with the aliens, but,

The long-haired man next to him suddenly spoke.

"What I am most unhappy about is being ordered."

The entire Divine Prison was almost all those strong men from the former top star domain. They did not choose to join the Divine Dynasty and were eventually imprisoned here.

So most people think the same as this long-haired man.

However, that was many years ago after all.

Some things will become.

When Lu Xue also heard the words of the long-haired man, she also understood.

"Do you know?"

"I can give you freedom, and I can also deprive you of freedom."

As soon as these words were said, the long-haired man was stunned and then laughed.

"Just you?"

"Girl, I admit that you are indeed not low in your status, but that doesn't mean your strength. If your invincible mother is still here now, I would respect her three points. It's a pity,"

"Hmph.."

The long-haired man didn't finish speaking, but the meaning was self-evident.

"Fuck, I can't bear it anymore!"

"Without dealing with you, can the mistress mother do it himself?"

Boom!

At this moment, Ao Qing on the side suddenly burst out.

The terrifying dragon power continued to pour out from the body of proud green.

Suddenly, the long-haired man's face changed drastically.

At this moment, he knew, and underestimated the five-clawed dragon that had been standing by.

At the same super god realm, he actually felt a strong sense of oppression.

Immediately, the long-haired man turned to look at Lei Yin who was still hesitating, and suddenly spoke, "Lei Gou, do you really want to stay in this dark cage for the rest of your life?"

"If you don't want to, then go out with me!"

When Lei Yin heard the words of the long-haired man, he was suddenly impulsive, but when he saw Lu Xue's cold gaze in his eyes, Lei Yin suddenly woke up a lot.

In the end, Lei Yin chose to remain silent.

Seeing this, the long-haired man swears and then uses his magical powers.

boom!

The huge vibration immediately attracted many powerful people from the Divine Dynasty.

Everyone rushed towards the direction of the Divine Prison.

And inside the divine prison.

Puff ~

A mouthful of scarlet blood spurted out of the long-haired man's mouth.

His expression was extremely horrified. He never expected that this five-clawed dragon would be so powerful.

Since he was at the same level, he rarely lost.

But this time, he was almost crushed.

"Young master, stay still and watch me vent your anger."

Ao Qing stared at the long-haired man with anger, and then swung his dragon tail and slammed towards him.

Boom!

The space exploded, and countless cells suddenly became restless.

Seeing this scene, the prison guard who had been shrinking behind suddenly changed his face.

"Your Highness, it's not good. The seal is loose!"

Hearing this, Lu Xue frowned slightly, "What do you mean?"

"The seal is loose, and some of the strong men in this prison may escape."

Hearing this, Lu Xue snorted coldly, "With me here, I wonder who can leave here."

The next moment, an ancient bell appeared in Lu Xue's hand.

Chaos Bell!

Buzz——

Outside, everyone was horrified to find that a huge ancient bell suddenly covered the entire God Prison, and no matter what means everyone used, they could not enter.

In just a moment, the sound of fighting gradually stopped.

"Ah!!"

"I was wrong, I was wrong, give me another chance, I, I will kill the aliens again,"

The long-haired man was defeated by Ao Qing and was soon suppressed.

At this time, the long-haired man regretted his decision and begged for mercy.

Seeing this, Lu Xue said directly: "Kill him."

Swish!

As soon as the voice fell, the long-haired man was immediately beheaded.

This scene made Lei Yin sweat coldly.

At this time, Lu Xue's eyes suddenly looked at him.

Plop!

Lei Yin knelt down directly in front of Lu Xue.

"Miss, I really know I was wrong. From now on, I am willing to serve you like a dog and horse, and follow you forever!"

Facing the fear of death, Lei Yin chose to follow his heart directly.

Hearing this, Lu Xue chuckled and said, "Oh? Aren't you practicing the Way of Thunder and have a hot temper?"
